# PREAUTH

> Every page of the PREAUTH module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Pre-authorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/api/preauth): The Pre-authorisation calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Payer: send the pre-authorisation response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/api/preauth/endpoints/preauth-v1-preauth-on-submit): Payer returns the ClaimResponseBundle for a pre-authorisation (approved, partially approved, queried or rejected) to the provider via NHCX.
- [Provider: submit a pre-authorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/api/preauth/endpoints/preauth-v1-preauth-submit): Provider submits, resubmits, enhances or answers a query on a pre-authorisation Claim bundle (Claim.use preauthorization); NHCX routes it to the payer.
- [Provider receives the pre-authorisation response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/api/preauth/endpoints/preauth-webhook-v1-preauth-on-submit): Hosted by the provider. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/preauth/on_submit, with the headers and the sealed...
- [Payer receives a pre-authorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/api/preauth/endpoints/preauth-webhook-v1-preauth-submit): Hosted by the payer. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/preauth/submit, with the headers and the sealed payload the...
- [Pre-authorisation errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/nhcx/v1/api/preauth/errors): What Pre-authorisation returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
